newsitem.title: UK: Sri Lanka dollar FRN due next week - dealers.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka dollar FRN due next week - dealers.

text.p: Sri Lanka's expected $50 million FRN was likely to be launched next week, dealers said on Friday.
The deal, to be jointly lead managed by Citibank International and ING Barings, will have a three-year maturity with a put after two years.
Price talk was the mid- to low-100s basis points over Libor, syndicate managers said.
"Interest in the deal has been very strong and the issue may be increased," a banker familiar with the transaction said.
"Sri Lanka held well-attended roadshows in Asia, Bahrain and London and the investor response has been good," he said.
In a recent interview, Sri Lankan Central Bank governor A.S. Jayawardena said the FRN would be launched to set a benchmark for private sector issuers from Sri Lanka.
The deal will supplement a $20 million grant from the World Bank and the Asian Development Bank for infrastructure development.
Jayawardena said the issue might be an incentive for the private sector to raise much-needed infrastructure investment. -- Aline van Duyn, London Newsroom +44 171 542 7748
